messages:
Theo (security): Published the BYO-Keystore & HSM Integration Guidance for Private/VPC installs. This covers cert provisioning, attestation flow, and FIPS notes. KB: https://internal.kb/redwood/onprem-byo-keystore

Anika (infra): Short summary: customers can bring their own KMS/HSM via PKCS#11 or cloud KMS edge connectors. We included a step-by-step for key material import and a fallback mode when the HSM is unreachable.

Ben (eng): Important: agent v3.2+ adds `kms.provider: external` and an `hsm.healthcheck` endpoint. No forced upgrade but recommend v3.2 for production. Sample values.yaml in KB.

kms-bot: KB entry posted: /kb/onprem-byo-keystore-2026-04-02  requested reviewers: eng-platform, security, legal

Leah (legal): Reviewed. Add explicit text for acceptance criteria when customers request key escrow support. Also, flag the contract addendum for customers using third-party HSMs in certain jurisdictions. I'll add language tomorrow.

Marisol (customer-success): For CS: can we get a one-pager explaining support boundaries (what support can do if customer-managed keys fail) and the recommended runbook for failover? Some customers want proactive testing steps.

Theo (security): One-pager attached in KB. Key points: (1) we never hold unencrypted key material unless under written escrow, (2) attestation requires a signed cert chain and nonce exchange, (3) fallback uses ephemeral symmetric wrapping keys stored in customer-managed vault.

Anika (infra): Implementation snippet:
```
# values.yaml
crypto:
  kms:
    provider: external
    type: pkcs11 # or cloud-kms
  hsm:
    healthcheckPath: /hsm/status
```

Ben (eng): Note on migrations: clusters upgrading from built-in keystore must run the migration tool (cli: redwood migrate-keystore --cluster <id>) before switching to external. We added a dry-run mode.

Leah (legal): Also, add privacy & export control note: some customers in export-restricted regions cannot export key material off-host; we must document exceptions.

kms-bot: Please review: eng-platform, eng-security, customer-success by EOD Tue.

Marisol (customer-success): Scheduling webinar Thurs 10am PT to walk pilot customers through the flow. I'll drop invites to #customer-success.

Theo (security): Action items: (1) @Leah draft escrow/contract language by Tue, (2) @Ben publish migration CLI dry-run example, (3) @Anika add healthcheck API spec and curl. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
